about: Patch layout for the inner notebook sphere. Sources are atlas.json slots. mode camera: what the landing camera sees (NDC rect). mode dir: yaw/pitch/roll in degrees, width is the angular width. crop is u0,v0,u1,v1 of the source. Feather and extend are fractions of the patch half size. gamma darkens the ink lines (paper stays), bias softens the wall.

patches.note: the quiet field of small studies behind the landing network, so the centre is never blank paper (crop and mask keep the Grok mark out)
the Creation of AI centrepiece, the gap between the fingertips on the network's nucleus; used once
the zenith: Markus's redrawn up view, image top toward +Z so it reads upright when tilting up from the landing
above the landing view, up to the zenith: the unused front face, cropped clear of its Vitruvian figure (the scene has one)
quiet studies right above the network (the target's tree and gears cell); the wash keeps the core's own backdrop clear
